scope: optional macOS chosen swapchain/layer color identity diagnostic only
conclusions: Swapchain colorSpace starts None and is assigned alongside actual format only after successful native create/images/views. It reads the format actually supplied to VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR, not an enumerated supported format.
Construction-only env guard is cached; disabled path performs no ObjC/CF color calls. Enabled path requires an actual created chain and reads CAMetalLayer.colorspace without modifying it.

Get-rule CFType retain/drop balances both borrowed layer property and separately owned CGColorSpace. Actual CF type and CFEqual(sRGB framework object) are checked, not pointer equality or a string guess. Pinned core-graphics0.23.1 exposes the exact type_id/create_with_name APIs and foreign-types0.5 trait used by candidate.
Existing resize/suspend/shutdown/present policies and native descriptor creation parameters are unchanged by this diagnostic.

official_sources.claim: Official tag lines474..478 assigns kCGColorSpaceSRGB for SRGB_NONLINEAR; reviewer browsed exact primary source. It is not installed dylib commit identity proof.
Referenced platform contract; reviewer web view required JavaScript and its Markdown click failed, so this report does not add an independently fetched Apple-body quotation.

limitations: Actual chosen format/layer identity has not been executed by reviewer. Must record emitted values from preserved root binary.
Only construction is sampled; no inference about resize/recreate/resume, other displays or OS compositor scanout.
If no successful native chain exists (e.g. zero startup extent), enabled diagnostic explicitly errors rather than inventing a colorSpace; default off behavior unchanged.
This read-only probe alone does not implement or validate an automatic ICC transform and is not proof all driver versions behave alike.
